data.narrative:
ForSight Robotics is a Series B biotech company led by Daniel Glozman (CEO), Joseph Nathan (President/CMO), and Moshe Shoham (Chief Scientist), having raised $195M to date. The valuation analysis triangulates across a comp universe of 3 public companies (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 8 private peers in Biotech & Health, including same-stage reference points Eikon Therapeutics ($539M, Series B) and later-stage peers Colossal Biosciences ($10.3B), Chai Discovery ($3.8B), and New Limit ($3.1B).

Two valuation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis applies a 1.9x step-up multiplier to the $195M total raised as a proxy baseline, implying a $370M post-money valuation. Peer-median analysis across the four identified comparables yields a $3.5B midpoint valuation, with a range spanning $539M (Eikon, Series B floor) to $10.3B (Colossal, Series C ceiling). Public-comp anchoring via P/S multiple cannot be applied due to unavailable revenue data, common for private companies.

The two applicable methods produce a wide triangulated range: low of $315M, median of $1.9B, and high of $4.0B. The stage-progression result sits at the lower bound, while peer median anchors the upper half. Key uncertainties include revenue scale and trajectory relative to the peer cohort, timing and size of the next financing round, and the wide dispersion among Series C comparables, which suggests significant heterogeneity in investor expectations at this stage.
